items.title: 13.9 Ghaliz sulfuric acid ke saath halides (X-) ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.9, printed page 299.

blocks.text: Halide ions ghaliz sulfuric acid se mukhtalif tarah react karte hain; products aur reaction ki nau'iyat group mein neeche badalti hai. Sodium fluoride ke saath hydrogen fluoride ke dhuen bante hain, NaF(s) + H2SO4(l) se NaHSO4 + HF(g); HF kamzor reducing agent hai aur aage react nahi karta. Sodium chloride ke saath hydrogen chloride ke dhuen: NaCl(s) + H2SO4(l) se NaHSO4 + HCl(g). Bromide ke saath hydrogen bromide ke bhaap jaise dhuen aur bromine ke bhoore dhuen sulfur dioxide ki boo ke saath bante hain, ek redox reaction jis mein HBr sulfuric acid ko SO2 mein reduce karta aur khud bromine mein oxidise hota hai: NaBr + H2SO4 se NaHSO4 + HBr, phir 2HBr + H2SO4 se Br2 + SO2 + 2H2O. Sodium iodide ke saath hydrogen iodide ke dhuen, iodine ke banafshi dhuen aur H2S ki boo: HI taqatwar reducing agent hai jo sulfuric acid ko H2S mein reduce karta aur I2 mein oxidise hota hai: NaI + H2SO4 se NaHSO4 + HI, phir 8HI + H2SO4 se 4I2 + H2S + 4H2O. Fluoride se iodide tak halide ions ki barhti reducing taqat zyada pecheeda reactions deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne 2HBr(s) + H2SO4 se Br2(g) + 2SO2(g) + 2H2O likha hai. Yeh balanced nahi: ek H2SO4 se sirf ek SO2 banta hai, is liye sahi 2HBr + H2SO4 se Br2 + SO2 + 2H2O hai. Kitab ne HBr aur HI ko (s) yani solid bhi likha hai; dono yahan gas (g) hain.

blocks.prompt: KI ghaliz H2SO4 se kaise react karta hai, aur yeh iodide ki reducing taqat ke bare mein kya dikhata hai (Quick Check 13.5a, c)?
blocks.explanation: KI + H2SO4 se KHSO4 + HI, aur phir hydrogen iodide acid ko reduce karta hai: 8HI + H2SO4 se 4I2 + H2S + 4H2O, banafshi iodine bukharat aur hydrogen sulfide ki sare andon jaisi boo ke taur par nazar aata hua. Sulfur ko +6 se -2 tak reduce karna dikhata hai ke iodide bohat taqatwar reducing agent hai, bromide (jo sirf SO2 tak pohnchta hai) ya chloride (jo acid ko bilkul reduce nahi karta) se kahin taqatwar.

items: Ghaliz H2SO4 har sodium halide se HX nikalta hai (NaX + H2SO4 se NaHSO4 + HX); F- aur Cl- wahin rukte hain, Br- aage Br2 + SO2 tak (bhoore dhuen, SO2 boo), I- I2 + H2S tak (banafshi dhuen, H2S boo): reducing taqat group mein neeche barhti hai.
